importantNote: Permanent fix for Service Worker auto-activation (skipWaiting + clients.claim + controllerchange auto-reload) for seamless hands-free updates.

items: Enforced automatic `self.skipWaiting()` on install and `self.clients.claim()` on activate in `sw.js`.
Added `controllerchange` listener in `updateManager.js` to automatically activate code changes without manual refresh.
Enforced immediate initial `loadView` execution on app startup so your account home page, playlists, and songs render instantly.
Non-blocking background cloud synchronization for user playlists, favorites, and profile data.
